work.description: Gregory of Nazianzus's oration for the feast of the Theophany, the Nativity. Sections 9-10 place the creation of the heavenly and angelic powers before the material world, the Greek opinion Aquinas weighs at ST I q. 61 a. 3. A locus is the section.
